findings.failure_path: If the first wrong transition occurs in an external or unchangeable producer, the rule requires fixing an unowned location and rejects validation at the owned ingestion boundary. An agent can therefore stall or allow malformed data to continue into the system instead of enforcing the local contract.
findings.smallest_fix: Qualify the rule: fix the transition when it is owned and changeable; otherwise record the upstream cause and enforce the contract at the nearest owned boundary. Mirror that qualification in the playbook and source-register row.
